title: Co-brand Asset Licensing & Acceptance Guide
body:
Purpose:
This doc is a working guide for accepting partner co-branding assets and copy for cloud marketplace listings (AWS/Azure/GCP) and co-marketing tiles. It combines creative specs, licensing/legal acceptance criteria, sample copy variants, and a lightweight signoff matrix to speed partner launches while protecting brand and legal risk.

Scope:
- Applies to all external partner tiles where Redwood brand and partner brand appear together (co-branded tiles, joint trials, joint landing pages).
- Covers static assets (logos, marks), creative (tiles, hero banners), listing copy (short tile, long description, bullets), legal/license checks, and technical entitlements (trial SKUs, billing metadata).

Stakeholders (who to loop in):
- GTM owner: Aisha Patel (coordinator)
- Partner PM: (partner side)
- Legal: Ben Carter (brand and trademark review)
- Design: Marco Li (asset QC)
- Product/Integration: Priya Nair (SKU & trial plumbing)
- Engineering: Listing PR owner for deploy & telemetry

Required assets checklist (submit these to go/marketplace-assets):
1) Official partner logo (SVG + PNG 3000px) and monochrome variants
2) Clearspace diagram + brand usage notes (PDF)
3) Approved tagline for tile (short, 8–10 words)
4) 2 hero banners: 1200x628 and 1600x400 (PNG, flattened, 72dpi, sRGB)
5) 3 screenshots of integration (1920x1080 recommended) with redacted PII
6) Company description (50–70 char short title; 200–400 char long description)
7) Legal contact and licensing statement (explicit grant for logo usage; point of contact for takedown)
8) Back-link URL for partner-specific landing page and tracking params

Asset technical specs (quick reference):
- Logos: SVG preferred; PNG @3000px for raster fallback, transparent background. Provide white and dark-background versions.
- Banners: sRGB, flatten layers, max file size 1.5MB. No text smaller than 16pt.
- Screenshots: remove any customer PII; use lorem data if needed.

Legal & licensing acceptance criteria (hard stops):
- Signed logo license (email or PDF) that allows Redwood to display partner marks in marketplace tiles and co-marketing for the duration of the listing.
- Trademark notice: partner must provide correct trademark symbol usage; legal to verify.
- No disallowed claims: partner copy must not claim regulatory compliance they cannot prove. If partner includes healthcare/finance claims, attach compliance proof.
- Indemnity/usage constraints: Legal must confirm there are no restrictions that conflict with Redwood’s policies (e.g., confidentiality-only logos).

Creative acceptance checklist (design QA):
- Contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 between text and background on tile overlays
- Logo clearspace respected in both tile sizes
- CTA copy variants provided: one focused on trial, one on demo, one on docs
- Accessibility: alt text provided for all images and screenshots

Marketplace copy guidance (examples + variants)
- Tile title (short): "PartnerName + Redwood Inference: Low-latency LLM serving"
- Short tile (50–70 chars): "Scale LLM inference with PartnerName + Redwood — secure, low-latency."
- Long description (200–350 chars): "PartnerName integrates with Redwood Inference to deliver enterprise-grade LLM inference across hosted and private deployments. Combine PartnerName’s data connectors with Redwood’s runtime and observability to achieve predictable latency, reduced token costs, and secure VPC deployments. Start a 14-day trial or contact sales for a demo."
- Bullet bank (choose 3–5):
  • "Predictable latency at <50ms p50 for common prompts"
  • "Dedicated GPU pools with autoscaling and SLAs"
  • "Enterprise security: VPC, KMS, and audit logs"
  • "Smart routing: save cost by routing low-priority requests to quantized variants"
  • "Built-in observability and per-route cost breakdowns"

Copy tone and constraints:
- Use active voice. Avoid technical jargon that marketplace buyers won’t understand (limit deep infra terms to long description).
- Avoid superlatives: don’t use "best" or undocumented performance claims. Use quantifiable statements with data source citation if possible.

SKU / Trial / Billing metadata checklist (product owner action items):
- SKU name (internal) and public listing name mapping
- Trial entitlement: duration (default 14 days) and quota (token limit or call count)
- Trial provisioning flow: API key vs. provisioned tenant; document endpoint + webhook for provisioning confirmation
- Billing hook: meter id and any free-tier mapping
- Cancellation and renewal messaging copy for marketplace listing

Security & compliance notes:
- Ensure no sample contains real customer PII or secrets.
- If partner requests private deployment tile, attach compliance appendix and contact SRE for deployment pattern review.

Signoff matrix (initial template — fill and attach e-mail approvals):
- Creative QA: Marco Li — pending
- Legal license review: Ben Carter — pending
- Product SKU mapping: Priya Nair — pending
- GTM copy approval: Aisha Patel — pending
- Engineering deploy & telemetry: (engineer) — pending

Launch checklist (pre-publish):
- Asset upload to go/marketplace-assets and confirm URLs
- Copy pasted into marketplace console draft and screenshots uploaded
- End-to-end QA: click-throughs, tracking params, partner landing link verified
- Telemetry tags: listing_id and partner_id present in outgoing events
- Smoke test: provisioning trial account via marketplace flow

Post-launch monitoring (first 30 days):
- Weekly: impressions and conversions (GTM dashboard)
- Daily x3: basic telemetry sanity check (errors, provisioning failures)
- 30-day: go/no-go review for paid conversion campaign and co-marketing spend

Sample legal snippet to request from partner (one-paragraph copy to include in email):
"By providing the logo and creative assets, PartnerName grants Redwood Inference a non-exclusive, worldwide license to reproduce and display PartnerName’s logos and trademarks in connection with Redwood’s marketplace listing and co-marketing activities for the duration of the listing. PartnerName warrants it has the right to grant this license and will notify Redwood of any required trademark attributions.

Unresolved questions / TODOs:
- Confirm partner’s internal signoff SLA (target 5 business days).
- Verify whether partner requires pre-approval for every copy update (recommended: only material changes).
- Decide default trial token quota for partner trials tied to enterprise-friendly workloads.

Owner notes / workflow tips:
- Ask partners for a single .zip package with all assets and a single PDF with legal contact + license statement to speed review.
- Use the copy variants in this doc as the starting point — don’t redevelop tile copy in the console UI.
- If Legal rejects an asset, capture rationale as a short bullet in the ticket to speed remediations.

If you’re the GTM owner for a partner and need a quick checklist export for the partner, copy the section "Required assets checklist" and send it along with the sample legal snippet.
